# FlickAtlas

> FlickAtlas is your global guide to movies and TV shows — full cast & crew,
> budgets vs box office earnings, upcoming release dates and celebrity
> filmographies for Bollywood, World Cinema and Lollywood (Pakistani cinema
> and drama serials). Figures are reported from named sources; where no
> reliable figure exists the page says so instead of guessing.

## Sections

- [Home](https://flickatlas.co.uk/): Spotlight, Coming Soon, Box Office, Now on OTT, Trending Worldwide, Release Calendar, Pakistani Dramas.
- [Movies](https://flickatlas.co.uk/movies): all published movies, filterable by industry (Bollywood / World Cinema / Pakistani), year and sort.
- [TV Shows](https://flickatlas.co.uk/tv): all published TV series.
- [Box Office](https://flickatlas.co.uk/box-office): day-wise India Net and overseas collections, with worldwide totals where reported.
- [Coming Soon / Most Awaited](https://flickatlas.co.uk/most-awaited): upcoming releases and festival titles.
- [Now on OTT](https://flickatlas.co.uk/ott): movies and TV series currently streaming, by platform.
- [News](https://flickatlas.co.uk/news): entertainment headlines; each story has its own page.
- [Pakistani Dramas](https://flickatlas.co.uk/dramas): drama serials with per-episode guides and summaries.
- [Celebrities](https://flickatlas.co.uk/celebrities): actor and director profiles with filmographies.
- [Trailers](https://flickatlas.co.uk/trailers): latest trailers.
- [About](https://flickatlas.co.uk/about): what FlickAtlas covers and how figures are sourced.
- [Contact](https://flickatlas.co.uk/contact): contact the FlickAtlas team.

## Notes for AI readers

- Detail pages are addressed as /movie?id=<TMDB id>, /show?id=<TMDB id>,
  /news-item?id=<story id> and /box-office-day?title=<TMDB id>&day=<n>.
  The full list of detail URLs is in /sitemap.xml.
- Box office figures are day-wise India Net unless a page states a worldwide
  total; "Not reported" means no reliable figure was found, not zero.
- News listings show only the last 24 hours of headlines; older stories stay
  reachable at their own URLs.
